active: 3
zero redundancy (active == N)

# Preview only; no -y means no fencing and exit code 7.

Changes write acceptance on one node. One-node fencing does not necessarily block an entire quorum; use fence-quorum for deliberate quorum intervention. Re-run with -y only after reviewing the node and quorum impact.
logstore fence-quorum: wp logstore fence-quorum my-channel 0 --reason "Verified writer recovery" --etcd 127.0.0.1:32379 --meta-prefix milvus-prod/woodpecker

Selected ...
# Preview only; without -y no RPC fencing is committed (exit 7).
Acceptance not given / too few selected reachable members

The command previews quorum impact and requires acceptance (-y bypasses the prompt). Fencing can interrupt writes and trigger rolling/recovery; it does not repair data. Re-run the reviewed command with -y to commit.

READER      OPEN_POS  CURRENT  LAST_REPORT  OPEN_FOR  STATE
reader-123  7:0       7:50     3s           5m        live

Log my-channel (id 42) — no live readers
# Or a stale report: check activity and namespace before declaring a stall.

Reads leased registration under readers/<logId>/. No live readers means no usable registration here, not no Milvus queries. Reports normally refresh every 30 seconds; compare two snapshots to establish progress. Lease expiry or wrong namespace can hide readers.
log scan: wp log scan my-channel --mode raw --bucket milvus-bucket --root-path milvus/wp --etcd 127.0.0.1:32379 --meta-prefix milvus-prod/woodpecker

SEGMENT STATE META LAST REACHES REPLICAS VERDICT
1 Active -1 (open) - 3/3 open
Per replica: local_empty / none / no_local_blocks

REACHES is the union of observed local ranges; - means none observed. 3/3 counts usable inspection responses, not three healthy data copies. quick checks structure; raw verifies local blocks. Sealed/compacted data in object storage is not verified. Explicit bucket/root-path resolves empty or unloaded targets; pending writes are not inspected.
segment inspect: wp segment inspect my-channel 1 --bucket milvus-bucket --root-path milvus/wp --etcd 127.0.0.1:32379 --meta-prefix milvus-prod/woodpecker

BLOCK ENTRIES READABLE RECOVERABLE STATUS
- - - - no_local_blocks
Block 0: checksum mismatch; entry 50 corrupt; later good entries

Walks local blocks and records to locate damage boundaries; it can report later recoverable entries despite a bad block. no_local_blocks says nothing about shared object integrity. Use actual timestamps/metadata separately; --max-blocks bounds the survey.
segment probe: wp segment probe my-channel 1 --bucket milvus-bucket --root-path milvus/wp --etcd 127.0.0.1:32379 --meta-prefix milvus-prod/woodpecker
SOURCE object_storage  SERVED 0-0 (1)  OUTCOME end_of_file  VERDICT served
Completed expected 99, replica stops at 49 → short / RedFinding if all fail

Actually probes sequential entry reads and stops at a failure or bound. 0-0 (1) means one entry, ID 0. Object storage responses share one copy. Active tail/no local data has unknown final boundary and must not be called a permanent stall; Completed shortfall is compared to metadata. cap_reached is a bound, not EOF.
